in_adapters_note: Every source of vendor data is an adapter: the working REST and CSV connectors, the mocked ERP families, the registry check and the Excel importer. Each pull writes observations that record where the value came from.
in_sync_log_note: Every run, whether it wrote anything or not. A run that could not reach its source is recorded as failed with no records — never as an empty success.
in_key_once_note: Only the hash is stored, so this is the only time the key can be read. Copy it now; if it is lost, revoke it and create a new one.
in_webhooks_note: Each delivery is signed with the subscription's own secret over the raw request body and the delivery timestamp. Verify the signature before parsing the payload — docs/integration-guide.md has a worked example.
in_secret_once_note: It is never returned again by any endpoint. Store it where the receiving service can read it, and verify every delivery with it.
in_event_log_note: The same stream the webhooks deliver. A system that would rather poll reads GET /events with an API key and a since cursor.
in_upload_note: An .xlsx application form or scoring workbook. The preview parses the file and writes nothing; the register changes only when you confirm.
in_anomalies_note: What the parser found and could not decide on its own: stale certificates, percentages written two ways, dates as text, a sheet header naming a currency the figures are not in.
in_no_anomalies: The parser found nothing to flag.
in_mapping_note: Every cell that would be written, next to what the register currently holds. Clear a row to leave that field alone.
in_no_fields: The file carries no answered cells.
in_secret_note: The stored secret is never shown. Leave the masked value to keep it, clear the field to remove it, or type a new one to replace it.
in_field_map_note: Remote path → VendorIQ field code. A dotted path walks the response; a numeric segment indexes a list (d.results.0.Stceg).
in_import_sub: Upload a workbook, read the mapping and the anomalies, then write what you accept.
in_erp_sub: Endpoint, credential and field mapping, per vendor.
